description: A PR whose stated goal is removing a flip between full and incremental runs, where the reviewer showed the flip still happens. The reviewer left it a medium suggestion; the independent severity check (recorded answer) found it defeats the PR's own goal, so it blocks. A second finding the reviewer itself marked as missing the goal blocks too.

findings.title: Add a tie-breaker to the ordering
findings.body: Rows with the same updated_at can still come out in either order.

findings.title: The incremental filter still drops late rows
findings.body: The PR says it makes incremental and full runs agree; rows arriving late are still dropped by the incremental filter.

checks.reason: the PR's stated goal is to stop this flip, and ties still flip

body_contains: This blocks: the PR's stated goal is to stop this flip
